candidate.name: FACTORED_DP_EXTENSION_PROJECTION
candidate.input: W05 GENERAL_CNF frame and frozen 16-variable bridge only; exact truth/interface is inaccessible until candidate terminates.
candidate.internal_variables: original frame variables minus bridge variables
candidate.elimination: Exact Davis-Putnam elimination over original internal variables only; choose the current variable with minimum pos_count*neg_count, tie by variable id.
candidate.width_rule: Maintain physical CNF clause width <=3. Every non-tautological width-4 resolvent is immediately replaced by a fresh acyclic definitional OR-chain extension encoding whose existential projection is exactly that resolvent. Aux variables are never eliminated.
candidate.dedupe: Canonical clauses are deduplicated. No resolvent is dropped for being wide; width-4 is factored. Any generated width>4 is an integrity failure because width<=3 parents can resolve to at most width4.
candidate.terminal: All original internal variables eliminated; output K(B,A) contains only bridge and fresh auxiliary variables and must satisfy I(B)=EXISTS A K(B,A).

candidate_firewall: NO POSTHOC FALSE_POSITIVE MASKS FOR ROUTING
NO WIDTH4 STATE RETENTION; WIDTH4 MUST BE FACTORED OR INTEGRITY FAIL

post_candidate_control.allowed: After candidate terminates, invoke the independent exact W05 witness and test a deterministic panel against EXISTS-A satisfiability of K using the pre-existing exact DPLL verifier.
post_candidate_control.panel: all five R13 frozen k4 false-positive masks + first 16 exact-allowed masks + first 16 exact-disallowed masks not already in the five, ordered numerically

claim_ceiling: Calibration on an exposed world only. Even a PASS cannot establish generalization, a polynomial bound, SAT in P, or P=NP.
